We had a wonderful Time at this hotel. The staff were friendly and helpful. We had a beautiful suite with sun lounges on the balcony overlooking the ocean with magnificent views. The hotel is modern with all the necessary amenities. Breakfast is fresh and there is a good selection. The staff only wanted to help us and please. In afternoon , a DJ plays in the bar which creates a good vibe. There are decks built overlooking the water which have sun loungers ( be warned people keep them for hours on end without occupying them) . One can easily jump into the ocean or use steps provided to go for a swim in the clear ocean. Views are fantastic. The resort has water sports that one can book for a very costly fee. The concierge was wonderful and made some excellent restaurant recommendations and even booked us a beach club for the day which I would highly recommend. There are some lovely Restuarants 1.2 km away at the marina that serve wonderful fresh fish and meat. Some things I did notice which would make this hotel even better are: People tend to put their items down on the sun loungers very early and only arrive hours later and at times not at all, leaving those that genuinely want to sit on the loungers not able too do so. A policy of some sort should be implemented for this. It’s very unpleasant on holiday to worry about not getting a lounger. There was no information supplied about the hotel ( lots of QR codes for room service etc). No information supplied on any activities , which Restuarant’s they had and where. The hotel is priced in euros .and is expensive. Turkish Lira would be an advantage too. Most resorts have a happy hour or food and beverage special .There was no such thing at Mivara. Some background music whilst sitting on the loungers on the decks would be nice. Overall we had a wonderful stay and would definitely book again at Mivara.

My husband and I have been fortunate to stay at several 5 star hotels and although this hotel had beautiful grounds they definitely fell short of a five star experience. While the property and rooms were spacious, clean, and had excellent views - basic amenities did not function as they should have. Our air conditioner kept malfunctioning and we had to call maintenance multiple times to address, but they did not provide a lasting solution for during our stay. The waterfall shower did not work, and one of the sink drain stoppers was broken as well. And the baby crib was VERY broken and hazardous and even though I reported this to them they did nothing to remedy it. They did not offer turn down service, and when they did clean the room they discarded our robes without replacing them. We were happy with the breakfast service but nothing blew our minds. And although they say they are an English speaking hotel, while the front desk was able to help us, the restaurant and security did not speak any English, and we encountered issues trying to enter the property many times due to the language barrier. We did not have a bad experience but we did not have a five star experience and do not plan to return on our next trip to Bodrum.

I regret to inform you that my stay at this hotel in Bodrum was highly disappointing. The staff displayed a shocking level of uncooperativeness, compounded by a significant language barrier. The common toilets were unhygienic, and amenities like the Jacuzzi were poorly maintained. Vegetarian options were extremely limited and exorbitantly priced. Additionally, the hotel had strict policies against ordering food from outside and provided no flexibility with late check-outs. Despite requesting adjacent rooms, we were denied without a valid reason, later discovering the hotel was not fully occupied. Service during breakfast was subpar, with staff frequently claiming items were unavailable upon reorder. Room cleanliness was unsatisfactory, and the overall staff-to-guest ratio was inadequate. Shockingly, guests were even refused water at the in-house restaurants. Overall, for the price that we paid, this was a regrettable experience, and I strongly advise against patronizing this establishment.
